Who this is for

For founders who have built their freedom and want to spend it with the right people. A week abroad, a day at sea, a dinner that becomes a partnership.

  • Your business makes five figures a month or more.
  • You are building something real.
  • You care who is in the room.
  • You want more life outside the screen.

Three groups, one council

Inside the community, every member sits in one of three groups by monthly revenue, so the people around you are at your stage.

What we stand for

The standard every member is held to.

  1. 01

    Mutual growth

    Everyone gives as much as they take. You leave each trip better than you arrived, and so does the person next to you.

  2. 02

    Impact beyond ourselves

    Wealth is leverage, not the finish line. We build to change more than our own lives.

  3. 03

    Character first

    We vet for who you are as much as what you have built, and we turn away people who would make the room worse, even if they would pay.

  4. 04

    Life outside the screen

    Time together in person is the point. The best partnerships start at a table, not in a chat.

Questions?

What is Zenith Council?+

A private members club for founders. We host retreats and one-day masterminds in different countries throughout the year, for a small, vetted group.

Who can apply?+

Founders and operators whose business makes five figures a month or more. We look at values and what you bring to the group, as well as results.

How does the application work?+

Apply, then we arrange a short call. If it is a fit, we send your payment link and share the member calendar.

How much is membership?+

€1,500 a year. You can only join after applying and a short call, so there is no checkout on this page.

Do I have to join every trip?+

No. Choose what fits your schedule. Most members join one or two a year.

Can I attend an event without membership?+

Yes, at full price. Some events are open to guests. Dates and details are on the calendar above.

Do members pay less for trips?+

Yes. Members get 20% off every retreat and event. Non-members pay full price.

What else comes with membership?+

A private community in three groups by revenue (Bronze, Silver and Gold), calls with experts from the community every three weeks, and introductions to anyone you need to meet.

How do I ask something else?+

Message us on Instagram at @zenithcouncil.
